data.caution: Conditional advice. Anything left blank is not treated as confirmed. Wash it before using it again. Normal washing doesn't deal with chemical or biological contamination. Don't reuse cracked or broken glass or ceramics.
data.reason: Provisional advice: Reuse for this ceramic mug. Some information is still missing. Reuse it only after you've confirmed it's clean, intact, usable, and something you want to keep using.

source_details.scope_note: Principles for reusing tableware designed for repeated use. Not a safety certification of an item from a photo.
source_details.title: Reusable food service ware: collection, washing and return

source_details.scope_note: An example of a local policy that encourages reusable tableware. It isn't an acceptance rule for facilities across Indonesia.
source_details.title: Reusable tableware and sorting at the source

steps: Check that it's clean. This route needs a clean item.
Check for cracks and damage. Use this route only if the item is intact.
Make sure the item still works for its purpose.
Go ahead with reuse only if you want to keep using it.
Follow these steps only after the conditions above are met.
Check again that it's clean and has no cracks or sharp edges.
Use it for its intended purpose and follow the material or product instructions. Keeping usable tableware in service avoids extra waste.
